definitions.explanation: A personal shopping bag brought from home instead of using disposable plastic bags, promoted as an eco-friendly practice.

examples.japanese: マイバッグを{持|も}ってきた。
マイバッグを{忘|わす}れて{袋|ふくろ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I forgot my reusable bag and had to buy one.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}はマイバッグを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Recently, many people carry reusable bags with them.

notes:
マイバッグ became much more common after Japan started charging for plastic bags (レジ{袋|ぶくろ}{有料化|ゆうりょうか}) in July 2020. Many people now carry foldable bags in their purses or pockets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マイバッグを{持参|じさん}する (to bring one's own bag)
- マイバッグ{持参|じさん} (bring your own bag)
- {折|お}りたたみマイバッグ (foldable reusable bag)

RELATED TERMS:
- エコバッグ: eco bag
- レジ{袋|ぶくろ}: plastic shopping bag
- レジ{袋|ぶくろ}{有料化|ゆうりょうか}: plastic bag charging
